name: USDA FNS — Characteristics of SNAP Households: Fiscal Year 2023 (SNAP Quality Control), State Tables B.1-B.2
organization: USDA Food and Nutrition Service, Evidence, Analysis, and Regulatory Affairs
citation: Monkovic, Mia, and Ben Ward. Characteristics of Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program Households: Fiscal Year 2023. USDA FNS, Alexandria, VA, 2025.
routing: Chronicle staging only (data/ledger/us_admin_outturns.jsonl), per the 2026-08-02 boundary ruling (issue #6): caseload tables are calibration material, never scorecard claims.
method: SNAP QC sample of 43,776 households, weighted to SNAP Program Operations totals by State (monthly participating households, participants and benefits) after removing erroneously paid and disaster-only households. Delaware lacks July and September 2023 sample data; Alaska and Guam use a single March 2023 weight.
geographies: 50 States, DC, Guam, the U.S. Virgin Islands, and the total
coverage_note: Tables B.1 (counts) and B.2 (averages) only; the report's other national and State tables (household composition, income sources, poverty status, age, disability) stay in raw/ unstaged.
